reviews.snippet: We ordered both Veg and non veg. We took parcel home. We expected tasty n good food but it was not tasty. In veg we took pulao but was stale food. We had been on trip and returned on this way and it was disappointed. Non veg was fresh and ok to eat. The restroom was in bad condition.
